failures.problem: The paper does state a post-hoc log2FC filter for a DESeq2 analysis in scope for this module: Methods > IPA says 'DEGs were identified using DESeq2 (ref. 2), applying a threshold of |log2 fold change| > 1 and an adjusted P value of <0.1' for its re-analysis of the public GSE84073 bulk RNA-seq dataset (HCC organoids vs tissue). This is a legitimate DESeq2 Wald-test bulk-RNA-seq analysis described in the paper's own Methods, distinct from the three lfcShrink/design-formula comparisons in 'Methods > RNA-seq data processing' that the extractor used as the article's primary analysis. The extractor documented the existence of multiple values for design, padj_cutoff and lfc_threshold_test (three separate comparisons each, noted in the 'note' field) but did not document or use this fourth, clearly-stated value for lfc_filter, and instead marked the parameter 'not reported' outright. This is an inconsistency: the same article's padj_cutoff line also silently drops the IPA section's '<0.1' value without a note (a softer version of the same gap), whereas lfc_filter drops its only literal value entirely.
failures.correct_value_if_known: |log2 fold change| > 1 (stated for the Methods > IPA re-analysis of GSE84073; the paper's three primary design-formula bulk comparisons in 'RNA-seq data processing' do not themselves state a post-hoc lfc_filter, only an lfcShrink fold-change threshold, already captured under lfc_threshold_test)
